Thanks Daniel — appreciate the clear asks. High level answers below; follow-ups and ownership outlined after.

SOC 2 evidence:
- Primary deliverable: most recent SOC 2 Type II report + auditor contact (PDF).
- Ongoing evidence: we provide an "evidence cadence" (quarterly snapshots of controls status and a named point of contact) for customers on Dedicated/Private within the order form addendum. For hosted customers we provide report + quarterly summary where requested (can be gated by NDA).

Pen test:
- We allow customer-initiated third-party tests. Redwood requires:
  - Shared scope doc (we typically sign a simple testing agreement),
  - A 2-week notice window,
  - IP allowlist + agreed hours (we prefer low-traffic windows),
  - No social engineering or physical tests.

Next steps / owners (proposed):
- Naomi (Security) — share the security exhibit redline (attached) and proposed MAP (mutual action plan).
- Karthik (Legal) — review AsterMed redlines in Security_Exhibit_v1_redline.docx and confirm acceptable pen-test language and audit scope.
- Laura (Account Exec) — coordinate dates for procurement and a single point of contact for the procurement team.

Proposed pen-test window: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-12 (can shift ±1 week). If ProbeSec is the vendor, share their contact and test scope so we can confirm staging access.

I attached: Security_Exhibit_v1_redline.docx and a 1-page mutual action plan (RINF-AsterMed_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Security_Exhibit_v1_redline.docx; RINF-AsterMed_MAP_v1.xlsx

Subject: Re: Security exhibit — evidence cadence & pen test window

Daniel — quick legal responses inline below. Apologies for the long form but wanted to be explicit so procurement has copy/paste language.

1) Quarterly controls export: Redwood can commit to providing a quarterly controls matrix export in CSV for the duration of the order form. We will redact vendor-sensitive details (e.g., internal sub-process names) and keep the export focused on control IDs, status, evidence artifact names, and date stamps. Suggested clause text: "Supplier will provide Buyer with a quarterly controls matrix CSV export (control_id, control_description, control_state, evidence_reference, evidence_date)."

2) Named point of contact: operationally this is an email-first model with a 24-hour SLA for acknowledgement and a best-effort 72-hour timeframe for resolution of evidence requests. For higher-severity audit escalations we provide an on-call rotation (Pager duty) contact. Suggested clause: "Supplier will designate an evidence POC (email and escalation phone) for the term. The POC will acknowledge routine requests within 24 hours and provide a best-effort resolution within 72 hours, with Pager escalation for critical audit requests."

3) Pen test guardrails: We accept ProbeSec as a vendor. Prior to testing we will require:
  - signed lighter-weight Testing Addendum (we can provide),
  - pre-test smoke plan (10–15 minute checklist),
  - IP allowlist (customer to provide),
  - scheduled test hours (low-traffic window).

I'll attach the Testing Addendum and proposed pen_test_scope_probeSec_v1.pdf to the thread. Laura/Priyo, please help commit to dates once AsterMed confirms.

-Karthik
General Counsel (Contracts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pen_test_scope_probeSec_v1.pdf
